When Neptune conjoins the North Node, imagination and forward movement meet, allowing a creative idea, compassionate project, intuitive pull, or less conventional plan to shape choices before its cost, timeline, or result is clear. Inspiration can be useful without being evidence. One concrete test gives the idea a chance to show what it can support outside the imagination.
